brief: Security fix SEC-4 (low severity). The planner's task card for this change is in docs/plans/2026-10-18-security-fix-specs.md (section SEC-4). Defect: several writers create token or private-state files with the process umask and narrow the mode afterwards, or write through a fixed temp name: jarvis/tools/discord.py (bot token), jarvis/google_auth.py, jarvis/spotify_auth._store, jarvis/v2/subagents.py _compact and jarvis/stt_settings.update; jarvis/v2/browser/host.py _write_private is a stricter reference. Contract: provide one shared private-write helper importable from both v1 and v2 code and use it in those writers. A file it writes is never readable by anyone but the owner at any moment from creation (even with umask 022); the update is atomic; it never follows a symlink at the target or at its temporary path; and on failure it leaves no partial or temporary file behind while the error still propagates. host._write_private keeps its name and signature. Spotify's rotating-token write must still persist the new token before it is used. Tests use a temporary HOME and config, never real tokens. Do not touch secrets.py credential-name rules or .env handling.
